notes.title: Spring monkey season comes
notes.content:
Dive into adventure with the main character Maka, immerse yourself in beautiful worlds and defeat all the enemies!

[h1]Storyline[/h1]
Somewhere in the fantasy world full of various creatures, there was a brave hero, willing to go to meet adventures! Help him achieve justice and save his people from evil creatures.

[h1]Genre[/h1]
Well known 2D platformer with adventure storyline.

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list][*] 4 Worlds
[*] 36 lelvels
[*] 4 Big Bosses
[/list]
[list]
[*] Melee attack
[*] Range attack
[*] Hit blocks to release random items 
[/list]

tags.feature: - Hit blocks to release random items
